description: Java class for producing Android test run configurations within an IDE, handling setup and detection of test classes, methods, and packages.

classes.name: AndroidTestConfigurationProducer
classes.description: Produces and manages Android test run configurations, including setup based on context and detection of test classes, methods, and packages.

methods.name: setupAllInPackageConfiguration
methods.description: Configures a test run for all tests within a specified package.

methods.name: setupClassConfiguration
methods.description: Configures a test run for a specific test class.

methods.name: setupMethodConfiguration
methods.description: Configures a test run for a specific test method.

methods.name: setupConfiguration
methods.description: Sets up common configuration parameters based on the context and module.

methods.name: isTestMethod
methods.description: Checks if a given method is a test method within a test class.

methods.name: setupConfigurationFromContext
methods.description: Creates a configuration based on the current context in the IDE.

methods.name: isConfigurationFromContext
methods.description: Checks if an existing configuration matches the current context.
